record_title: Sharp exponential constant for the AESZ 28 Apéry limit
scientific_context: For the AESZ no. 28 recurrence with Apéry limit C_n/A_n -> zeta(3)/7, this record determines the exact leading asymptotic of A_n and the sharp exponential error constant of the quotient.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result concerns this specific AESZ no. 28 recurrence and does not establish analogous constants for arbitrary Apéry limits, the root-of-unity q-recurrence, or odd-weight extensions, nor does it improve an irrationality measure for zeta(3). The closely relevant Sato--Tasaka work cited as in preparation by Bachmann was not available for full inspection, and the 2008 Calabi-Yau Apéry-limit literature was not exhaustively checked for this exact constant. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact recurrence, binomial-sum, Casoratian, and high-precision asymptotic verification for the AESZ no. 28 sequences.
Deterministic output of verify.py giving the two predicted constants and scaled convergence diagnostics.
